name: hybrid-rosa-sqs-order-processor
description: ROSA worker consumes order events from AWS SQS and exposes processed status via HTTP on OpenShift
kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-rosa-sqs-order-processor
    from:
      uri: "aws2-sqs:rosa-orders-queue"
      parameters:
        region: us-east-1
        waitTimeSeconds: 20
        visibilityTimeout: 60
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: orderId
            jsonpath: "$.orderId"
        - setProperty:
            name: customerId
            jsonpath: "$.customerId"
        - log:
            message: "ROSA processing order ${exchangeProperty.orderId} for customer ${exchangeProperty.customerId}"
        - setBody:
            simple: '{"orderId":"${exchangeProperty.orderId}","status":"PROCESSED","platform":"ROSA","region":"us-east-1"}'
        - marshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
- route:
    id: rosa-order-status-api
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/api/orders/health"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: GET
      steps:
        - setBody:
            constant: '{"status":"ready","platform":"ROSA","sqsQueue":"rosa-orders-queue"}'

name: hybrid-rosa-s3-document-api
description: REST API on ROSA that stores and retrieves documents in Amazon S3 using IRSA workload identity
kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-rosa-s3-document-api
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/documents/{action}"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST,GET
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: action
            simple: "${header.action}"
        - setProperty:
            name: docId
            simple: "${header.X-Document-Id}"
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.action} == 'upload'"
                steps:
                  - setHeader:
                      name: CamelAwsS3Key
                      simple: "documents/${exchangeProperty.docId}.json"
                  - to:
                      uri: "aws2-s3:rosa-documents-bucket"
                      parameters:
                        region: us-east-1
                  - setBody:
                      simple: '{"stored":true,"bucket":"rosa-documents-bucket","key":"documents/${exchangeProperty.docId}.json","platform":"ROSA"}'
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.action} == 'download'"
                steps:
                  - toD:
                      uri: "aws2-s3:rosa-documents-bucket?region=us-east-1&operation=getObject&key=documents/${exchangeProperty.docId}.json"
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - setHeader:
                    name: CamelHttpResponseCode
                    constant: "400"
                - setBody:
                    constant: '{"error":"Use action=upload or download with X-Document-Id header"}'
        - log:
            message: "S3 document ${exchangeProperty.action} on ROSA for ${exchangeProperty.docId}"

name: hybrid-rosa-sns-alert-fanout
description: OpenShift on AWS fans out operational alerts from Kafka to Amazon SNS topics by severity
kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-rosa-sns-alert-fanout
    from:
      uri: "kafka:platform-alerts"
      parameters:
        brokers: "my-cluster-kafka-bootstrap:9092"
        groupId: rosa-sns-fanout
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: severity
            jsonpath: "$.severity"
        - setProperty:
            name: alertMessage
            jsonpath: "$.message"
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.severity} == 'CRITICAL'"
                steps:
                  - setHeader:
                      name: CamelAwsSnsSubject
                      constant: "CRITICAL Alert - ROSA"
                  - to:
                      uri: "aws2-sns:critical-alerts-topic"
                      parameters:
                        region: us-east-1
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.severity} == 'WARNING'"
                steps:
                  - setHeader:
                      name: CamelAwsSnsSubject
                      constant: "Warning - ROSA"
                  - to:
                      uri: "aws2-sns:warning-alerts-topic"
                      parameters:
                        region: us-east-1
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - to:
                    uri: "aws2-sns:info-alerts-topic"
                    parameters:
                      region: us-east-1
        - log:
            message: "Alert ${exchangeProperty.severity} published to SNS from ROSA"

name: hybrid-rosa-dynamodb-session-cache
description: Session cache API on ROSA backed by Amazon DynamoDB for stateless OpenShift pods
kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-rosa-dynamodb-session-cache
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/session/{sessionId}"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: GET,PUT
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: sessionId
            simple: "${header.sessionId}"
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${header.CamelHttpMethod} == 'PUT'"
                steps:
                  - marshal:
                      json:
                        library: jackson
                  - setHeader:
                      name: CamelAwsDdbTableName
                      constant: "rosa-sessions"
                  - to:
                      uri: "aws2-ddb:rosa-sessions"
                      parameters:
                        region: us-east-1
                        operation: PutItem
                  - setBody:
                      simple: '{"saved":true,"sessionId":"${exchangeProperty.sessionId}","platform":"ROSA"}'
              - simple: "${header.CamelHttpMethod} == 'GET'"
                steps:
                  - setHeader:
                      name: CamelAwsDdbTableName
                      constant: "rosa-sessions"
                  - toD:
                      uri: "aws2-ddb:rosa-sessions?region=us-east-1&operation=GetItem&key=${exchangeProperty.sessionId}"
        - log:
            message: "DynamoDB session ${exchangeProperty.sessionId} on ROSA"

name: hybrid-rosa-lambda-async-worker
description: ROSA route offloads heavy compute to AWS Lambda while keeping orchestration on OpenShift
kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-rosa-lambda-async-worker
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/compute/offload"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: payload
            simple: "${body}"
        - marshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setHeader:
            name: CamelAwsLambdaFunctionName
            constant: "rosa-heavy-compute"
        - to:
            uri: "aws2-lambda:rosa-heavy-compute"
            parameters:
              region: us-east-1
              operation: invoke
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setBody:
            simple: '{"result":${body},"orchestrator":"ROSA","compute":"AWS Lambda"}'
        - log:
            message: "Lambda offload completed from ROSA OpenShift"

name: hybrid-rosa-kinesis-telemetry-ingest
description: Stream IoT telemetry from ROSA into Amazon Kinesis Data Streams for real-time analytics
kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-rosa-kinesis-telemetry-ingest
    from:
      uri: "kafka:device-telemetry"
      parameters:
        brokers: "my-cluster-kafka-bootstrap:9092"
        groupId: rosa-kinesis-writer
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: deviceId
            jsonpath: "$.deviceId"
        - marshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setHeader:
            name: CamelAwsKinesisPartitionKey
            simple: "${exchangeProperty.deviceId}"
        - to:
            uri: "aws2-kinesis:rosa-telemetry-stream"
            parameters:
              region: us-east-1
              operation: putRecord
        - log:
            message: "Telemetry from device ${exchangeProperty.deviceId} sent to Kinesis via ROSA"

name: hybrid-rosa-bedrock-ai-assist
description: AI assistant endpoint on ROSA using Amazon Bedrock for inference within the AWS network
kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-rosa-bedrock-ai-assist
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/ai/assist"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: userPrompt
            simple: "${body}"
        - setBody:
            simple: '{"prompt":"${exchangeProperty.userPrompt}","max_tokens":1024}'
        - to:
            uri: "aws-bedrock:anthropic.claude-3-sonnet"
            parameters:
              region: us-east-1
              operation: invokeModel
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setBody:
            simple: '{"response":${body},"platform":"ROSA","inference":"AWS Bedrock"}'
        - log:
            message: "Bedrock AI response served from ROSA OpenShift"

name: hybrid-aro-blob-document-store
description: Document store API on ARO using Azure Blob Storage with managed identity authentication
kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-aro-blob-document-store
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/aro/documents"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: docName
            simple: "${header.X-Document-Name}"
        - setHeader:
            name: CamelAzureStorageBlobBlobName
            simple: "documents/${exchangeProperty.docName}"
        - to:
            uri: "azure-storage-blob:arodocuments/docs-container"
            parameters:
              operation: uploadBlockBlob
        - setBody:
            simple: '{"stored":true,"container":"docs-container","blob":"documents/${exchangeProperty.docName}","platform":"ARO"}'
        - log:
            message: "Document stored in Azure Blob from ARO: ${exchangeProperty.docName}"

name: hybrid-aro-servicebus-orders
description: ARO order processing pipeline consuming from Azure Service Bus queue with dead-letter handling
kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-aro-servicebus-orders
    from:
      uri: "azure-servicebus:aro-orders-queue"
      parameters:
        subscriptionType: queue
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: orderId
            jsonpath: "$.orderId"
        - doTry:
            steps:
              - log:
                  message: "ARO processing order ${exchangeProperty.orderId} from Service Bus"
              - to:
                  uri: "direct:validate-order"
              - setBody:
                  simple: '{"orderId":"${exchangeProperty.orderId}","status":"CONFIRMED","platform":"ARO"}'
            doCatch:
              - exception:
                  - "java.lang.Exception"
                steps:
                  - log:
                      message: "Order ${exchangeProperty.orderId} failed - sending to DLQ"
                      loggingLevel: ERROR
                  - to:
                      uri: "azure-servicebus:aro-orders-dlq"
- route:
    id: validate-order
    from:
      uri: "direct:validate-order"
      steps:
        - log:
            message: "Validating order on ARO OpenShift"

name: hybrid-aro-eventhubs-telemetry
description: Bridge Kafka telemetry from ARO pods into Azure Event Hubs for Azure Monitor integration
kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-aro-eventhubs-telemetry
    from:
      uri: "kafka:aro-telemetry"
      parameters:
        brokers: "my-cluster-kafka-bootstrap:9092"
        groupId: aro-eventhubs-bridge
      steps:
        - marshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setHeader:
            name: CamelAzureEventHubsPartitionKey
            simple: "${header.deviceId}"
        - to:
            uri: "azure-eventhubs:aro-telemetry-hub"
            parameters:
              operation: sendEvents
        - log:
            message: "Telemetry forwarded to Azure Event Hubs from ARO"

name: hybrid-aro-cosmosdb-customer-sync
description: Sync customer profiles from ARO API into Azure Cosmos DB for global low-latency reads
kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-aro-cosmosdb-customer-sync
    from:
      uri: "timer:cosmos-sync"
      parameters:
        period: 120000
      steps:
        - setHeader:
            name: CamelHttpMethod
            constant: GET
        - to:
            uri: "http:customer-api.openshift-integration.svc:8080/api/customers?limit=50"
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - split:
            expression:
              jsonpath: "$[*]"
            steps:
              - setProperty:
                  name: customerId
                  jsonpath: "$.id"
              - marshal:
                  json:
                    library: jackson
              - to:
                  uri: "azure-cosmosdb:customers"
                  parameters:
                    database: integration
                    container: profiles
                    operation: upsertItem
              - log:
                  message: "Customer ${exchangeProperty.customerId} synced to Cosmos DB from ARO"

name: hybrid-aro-keyvault-secrets-loader
description: ARO startup route loads secrets from Azure Key Vault into OpenShift without hardcoding credentials
kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-aro-keyvault-secrets-loader
    from:
      uri: "timer:refresh-secrets"
      parameters:
        period: 300000
      steps:
        - to:
            uri: "azure-key-vault:database-connection-string"
            parameters:
              vaultName: aro-integration-kv
              operation: getSecret
        - setProperty:
            name: dbConnection
            simple: "${body}"
        - to:
            uri: "azure-key-vault:api-key-external-service"
            parameters:
              vaultName: aro-integration-kv
              operation: getSecret
        - setProperty:
            name: apiKey
            simple: "${body}"
        - log:
            message: "Secrets refreshed from Azure Key Vault on ARO (values not logged)"
        - setBody:
            constant: '{"secretsRefreshed":true,"platform":"ARO","source":"Azure Key Vault"}'

name: hybrid-aro-blob-to-servicebus
description: ARO pipeline: new blobs in Azure Storage trigger Service Bus notifications for downstream processing
kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-aro-blob-to-servicebus
    from:
      uri: "azure-storage-blob:aroevents/incoming-container"
      parameters:
        operation: listBlobFlatSegment
        delay: 30000
      steps:
        - split:
            expression:
              simple: "${body}"
            steps:
              - setProperty:
                  name: blobName
                  simple: "${body.name}"
              - setBody:
                  simple: '{"event":"BlobCreated","blob":"${exchangeProperty.blobName}","platform":"ARO","timestamp":"${date:now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}"}'
              - marshal:
                  json:
                    library: jackson
              - to:
                  uri: "azure-servicebus:blob-events-topic"
                  parameters:
                    subscriptionType: topic
              - log:
                  message: "Blob event ${exchangeProperty.blobName} published to Service Bus from ARO"

name: hybrid-aro-storage-queue-tasks
description: Background task worker on ARO consuming from Azure Storage Queue for async job processing
kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-aro-storage-queue-tasks
    from:
      uri: "azure-storage-queue:aro-background-tasks"
      parameters:
        visibilityTimeout: 30
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: taskId
            jsonpath: "$.taskId"
        - setProperty:
            name: taskType
            jsonpath: "$.type"
        - log:
            message: "ARO processing background task ${exchangeProperty.taskId} type=${exchangeProperty.taskType}"
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.taskType} == 'REPORT'"
                steps:
                  - log:
                      message: "Generating report on ARO for task ${exchangeProperty.taskId}"
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.taskType} == 'CLEANUP'"
                steps:
                  - log:
                      message: "Running cleanup on ARO for task ${exchangeProperty.taskId}"
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - log:
                    message: "Generic task handler on ARO"
        - setBody:
            simple: '{"taskId":"${exchangeProperty.taskId}","status":"DONE","platform":"ARO"}'

name: hybrid-gcp-pubsub-events
description: Event consumer on OpenShift GCP subscribing to Cloud Pub/Sub for cross-service notifications
kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-gcp-pubsub-events
    from:
      uri: "google-pubsub:gcp-integration-project:order-events-sub"
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: eventType
            jsonpath: "$.type"
        - setProperty:
            name: eventId
            jsonpath: "$.id"
        - log:
            message: "GCP Pub/Sub event ${exchangeProperty.eventType} id=${exchangeProperty.eventId} on OpenShift"
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.eventType} == 'ORDER_PLACED'"
                steps:
                  - log:
                      message: "Processing order placement from Pub/Sub"
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.eventType} == 'PAYMENT_CONFIRMED'"
                steps:
                  - log:
                      message: "Payment confirmed - triggering fulfillment"
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - log:
                    message: "Unhandled event type ${exchangeProperty.eventType}"

name: hybrid-gcp-storage-archive
description: Archive API on OpenShift GCP writing audit logs to Google Cloud Storage buckets
kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-gcp-storage-archive
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/gcp/archive"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: auditId
            simple: "${header.X-Audit-Id}"
        - marshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setHeader:
            name: CamelGoogleStorageObjectName
            simple: "audit/${date:now:yyyy/MM/dd}/${exchangeProperty.auditId}.json"
        - to:
            uri: "google-storage:gcp-audit-bucket"
            parameters:
              operation: createObject
        - setBody:
            simple: '{"archived":true,"bucket":"gcp-audit-bucket","platform":"OpenShift-GCP"}'
        - log:
            message: "Audit ${exchangeProperty.auditId} archived to GCS"

name: hybrid-gcp-bigquery-analytics
description: Stream business events from OpenShift on GCP into BigQuery for analytics and dashboards
kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-gcp-bigquery-analytics
    from:
      uri: "kafka:business-events"
      parameters:
        brokers: "my-cluster-kafka-bootstrap:9092"
        groupId: gcp-bigquery-writer
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: eventName
            jsonpath: "$.event"
        - marshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - to:
            uri: "google-bigquery:gcp-integration-project:analytics"
            parameters:
              datasetId: integration_events
              tableId: event_stream
              operation: insertTableData
        - log:
            message: "Event ${exchangeProperty.eventName} streamed to BigQuery from OpenShift GCP"

name: hybrid-gcp-pubsub-kafka-bridge
description: Bidirectional bridge between Cloud Pub/Sub and Kafka on OpenShift running on Google Cloud
kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-gcp-pubsub-to-kafka
    from:
      uri: "google-pubsub:gcp-integration-project:external-events-sub"
      steps:
        - marshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - to:
            uri: "kafka:internal-events"
            parameters:
              brokers: "my-cluster-kafka-bootstrap:9092"
        - log:
            message: "Pub/Sub message bridged to Kafka on OpenShift GCP"
- route:
    id: hybrid-gcp-kafka-to-pubsub
    from:
      uri: "kafka:outbound-gcp"
      parameters:
        brokers: "my-cluster-kafka-bootstrap:9092"
        groupId: gcp-pubsub-publisher
      steps:
        - to:
            uri: "google-pubsub:gcp-integration-project:outbound-events"
        - log:
            message: "Kafka message published to Cloud Pub/Sub from OpenShift GCP"

name: hybrid-gcp-storage-trigger-pipeline
description: GCS object polling on OpenShift GCP triggers Pub/Sub notifications for ETL pipelines
kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-gcp-storage-trigger-pipeline
    from:
      uri: "timer:gcs-poll"
      parameters:
        period: 60000
      steps:
        - to:
            uri: "google-storage:gcp-ingest-bucket"
            parameters:
              operation: listObjects
              prefix: "incoming/"
        - split:
            expression:
              simple: "${body}"
            steps:
              - setProperty:
                  name: objectName
                  simple: "${body.name}"
              - setBody:
                  simple: '{"event":"ObjectFinalized","object":"${exchangeProperty.objectName}","platform":"OpenShift-GCP"}'
              - marshal:
                  json:
                    library: jackson
              - to:
                  uri: "google-pubsub:gcp-integration-project:etl-triggers"
              - log:
                  message: "GCS object ${exchangeProperty.objectName} triggered ETL via Pub/Sub"

name: hybrid-gcp-pubsub-slack-notify
description: Operational alerts from Pub/Sub on OpenShift GCP forwarded to Slack webhook for on-call teams
kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-gcp-pubsub-slack-notify
    from:
      uri: "google-pubsub:gcp-integration-project:ops-alerts-sub"
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: alertLevel
            jsonpath: "$.level"
        - setProperty:
            name: alertMsg
            jsonpath: "$.message"
        - setBody:
            simple: '{"text":"[${exchangeProperty.alertLevel}] OpenShift-GCP: ${exchangeProperty.alertMsg}"}'
        - setHeader:
            name: CamelHttpMethod
            constant: POST
        - setHeader:
            name: Content-Type
            constant: "application/json"
        - to:
            uri: "https://hooks.slack.com/services/YOUR/SLACK/WEBHOOK"
        - log:
            message: "Alert ${exchangeProperty.alertLevel} forwarded to Slack from OpenShift GCP"

name: hybrid-gcp-multi-region-failover
description: Multi-region failover on OpenShift GCP: primary GCS with Pub/Sub failover to secondary region
kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-gcp-multi-region-failover
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/gcp/store"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: objectName
            simple: "${header.X-Object-Name}"
        - setProperty:
            name: content
            simple: "${body}"
        - doTry:
            steps:
              - setHeader:
                  name: CamelGoogleStorageObjectName
                  simple: "data/${exchangeProperty.objectName}"
              - setBody:
                  simple: "${exchangeProperty.content}"
              - to:
                  uri: "google-storage:gcp-primary-bucket"
                  parameters:
                    operation: createObject
              - setBody:
                  simple: '{"stored":true,"region":"us-central1","bucket":"gcp-primary-bucket"}'
              - log:
                  message: "Stored in primary GCS region from OpenShift GCP"
            doCatch:
              - exception:
                  - "java.lang.Exception"
                steps:
                  - log:
                      message: "Primary GCS failed - failing over to secondary region"
                      loggingLevel: WARN
                  - setBody:
                      simple: '{"event":"FAILOVER","object":"${exchangeProperty.objectName}"}'
                  - marshal:
                      json:
                        library: jackson
                  - to:
                      uri: "google-pubsub:gcp-integration-project:failover-storage"
                  - setBody:
                      simple: '{"stored":true,"region":"europe-west1","via":"failover-pubsub"}'
